package rulefixtures

import (
	"net/http"
	"time"
)

// scenario for middleware_mutates_domain_model_state: Middleware that writes business entities or persistence models as a side effect of request plumbing.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: warning.

type Order struct {
	ID         int
	Status     string
	Total      float64
	ModifiedAt time.Time
}

var currentOrder = &Order{ID: 42, Status: "pending", Total: 99.99}

func MutatingMiddleware(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		role := r.Header.Get("X-User-Role")
		if role == "admin" {
			currentOrder.Status = "approved"
			currentOrder.ModifiedAt = time.Now()
		}
		if r.Header.Get("X-Force") == "true" {
			currentOrder.Status = "cancelled"
			currentOrder.Total = 0.0
			currentOrder.ModifiedAt = time.Now()
		}
		next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
	})
}

func OrderHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
}
